name: Realistic Suppressors
description: A standalone Story Mode suppressor simulation managed by the ALLIN1 launcher.

systems.name: Realistic Suppressors
systems.description: Witness-aware stealth plus weapon-specific suppressor heat, glow, wear, and replacement behavior.

settings.label: Realistic suppressor stealth
settings.description: Suppressors reduce actionable gunshot noise without hiding close, visible, alerted, impact-adjacent, or sustained fire.

settings.label: Suppressor wear and breakage
settings.description: Rapid overheating damages suppressors until they fail and must be replaced. Disable this to retain heat and glow without permanent condition loss.

settings.label: Suppressor durability multiplier
settings.description: Scales suppressor life when breakage is enabled.
